basis: production public API GET /v2/tv/read (category=Cine / Series, view=day, 50 per page, paced 0.8 s) and /v2/catalog/slug/movie/<slug>, measured 2026-10-22 ~09:00 Madrid; no database access
limits: The public tv/read DTO does not expose program.mediaId, so the share of airings tied to a catalogue row is NOT measurable here (see legacy-enrichment-preflight).
Airing counts are the guide as served today; they are measurements of that moment, not of other days.

epgHorizon.conclusion: the production guide holds today + 2 days; a 7-day window never fills. Day 3 is also partial (6831 vs 9744 the day before).
